title: Composer Install Command Flow
interaction_flow: Installer::create pulls: Config, Package, DownloadManager, RepositoryManager, Locker, InstallationManager, EventDispatcher, AutoloadGenerator from Composer
InstallCommand → Installer: setDryRun / setDevMode / setPreferSource / setPreferDist / setOptimizeAutoloader / setPolicyConfig / setAuditConfig / ... (chained setters)
Installer.run → [alt: no lock file] set update=true
Installer.run → Installer: doInstall(localRepo) [or doUpdate if update=true]
Installer.doInstall → Solver: new Solver(policy, pool, io)
Installer.doInstall → InstallationManager: execute(localRepo, operations, devMode, runScripts, downloadOnly)
Installer.run → AutoloadGenerator: dump(config, localRepo, package, installationManager, 'composer', optimizeAutoloader, null, locker)
Installer.run → InstallationManager: ensureBinariesPresence(package) [for each installed package]
Installer.run → Auditor: audit(io, repoSet, policyConfig, packages, auditFormat, true, filterListProviderSet) [if auditConfig.audit=true]
key_relationships: InstallCommand depends_on Installer (creates via Installer::create static factory)
Installer depends_on IOInterface, Config, RootPackageInterface, DownloadManager, RepositoryManager, Locker, InstallationManager, EventDispatcher, AutoloadGenerator
Installer::create(io, composer) extracts all deps from Composer aggregate object
Installer.run() delegates to doInstall() (lock present) or doUpdate() (no lock / --update)
Installer.doInstall() uses Solver for platform compatibility check, LocalRepoTransaction for diff
EventDispatcher fires: PRE_COMMAND_RUN, COMMAND, PRE_INSTALL_CMD, PRE_OPERATIONS_EXEC, POST_INSTALL_CMD

method_signatures.InstallCommand::configure: configure(): void — registers install command options/arguments
method_signatures.BaseCommand::initialize: initialize(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): void — bootstraps Composer, fires PRE_COMMAND_RUN
method_signatures.Installer::run: run(): int — main install/update orchestration; returns ERROR_* const
method_signatures.InstallationManager::execute: execute(InstalledRepositoryInterface $repo, array $operations, bool $devMode, bool $runScripts, bool $downloadOnly): void

important_notes: InstallCommand::execute() checks for lock file via Locker::isLocked(); if absent, Installer falls back to update mode. PluginManager events (PRE_COMMAND_RUN, COMMAND) fire before install logic. Fluent setter pattern on Installer allows full config before run(). Autoloader dump and security audit are post-install steps within run(). Error codes: 0=success, 1=generic, 2=solver, 3=no-lock-partial, 4=lock-invalid, 5=audit-fail, 6=PSR-violation, 100=transport.
